panels.name: Ten years later
panels.summary: Ten years later. The wealthy country-rock superstar stands on a massive arena stage beneath blinding white and gold spotlights, fifty thousand fans cheering, but his posture is hollow, robotic, and emotionally bankrupt.
panels.caption: Ten years since the deal. Still on top, fifty thousand a night, but hollow.
panels.prompt: Wide shot, epic arena concert. Looking across the massive stage toward the audience, the wealthy country-rock superstar (tall 6-foot-1, handsome 29-year-old superstar features, slicked dark hair with fine strands falling loose, sharp gaunt cheekbones, haunted hollow dark eyes masking existential burnout, NOT elderly, NOT haggard, NOT 60 years old) stands mechanically under blinding white-and-gold arena spotlights. He wears an immaculate custom embroidered black-and-silver satin western suit with pearl-snap buttons and gold rings on his fingers, holding his polished custom jet-black acoustic guitar. Behind him, massive arena speaker stacks, overhead truss lighting rigs, and an endless roaring ocean of fifty thousand fan silhouettes in hazy blue and gold concert light. Complete rectangular black ink panel frame border enclosing all four sides with generous margins. Include a neatly positioned torn paper caption box fully contained within the upper portion of the frame with generous margin below the top edge (ensure all text is 100% visible, not cut off at borders) with the exact text: "Ten years since the deal. Still on top, fifty thousand a night, but hollow.". Use a messy handwritten marker font. Style: Highly detailed modern graphic novel panel, crisp clean ink linework with fine cross-hatching, rich digital texture, high-contrast arena lighting, clean cel and gradient shading, no messy watercolor wash, no blur.

panels.caption: Nights he lay awake counting days - tortured most by the open clock, because nobody had ever told him how long he had.
